notes: Independent manual semantic review of every sentence in all 35 books × eight languages (280 descriptions, 1680 sentences), against each complete English aboutBook source presentation. Checked topic and central message, localization equivalence, Romanian idiom, grammar, clarity, proposal qualifications, nonduplication of points, and preservation of fiction mystery and outcomes. Corrected 35 localization or scope issues; no unresolved source-fidelity or spoiler issues. Final source-ID coverage, six-sentence structure and sentence word limits pass the repository editorial validator; aggregate duplicate validation also passed.
